title: Signal: Workflow checks out the pull-request head ref (gha)
scope: A workflow file that declares pull_request_target and also checks out the head ref.
limitations: Line-based on the workflow file: it flags a checkout step that names the pull-request head ref, not the job's trigger or the full job graph, so a head checkout in an unprivileged pull_request workflow is also reported.
fpNotes: A pull_request workflow that checks out the head under read-only defaults is a common false positive.
